# Results (generated by `itb analyze`)

tau: +1 = the earlier probe in the block always had the higher price (price) / was written first (arrival); 0 = unrelated. Head-to-head: only pairs where the higher-priced probe was written later; +1 = price always won, -1 = arrival always won. p: permutation test within blocks; q: Benjamini–Hochberg within each level of this table (validators, clients, client + mode); a rule is claimed only at q < 0.05 with at least 10 pairs. Landed: all located probes (in the targeted leader's own blocks — the only ones used). Position: 0 = top of block, 1 = bottom.
